name: ironvault
description: MCP tool manifest for IronVault — encrypted AI/ML model management with versioning, conversion, compliance, RAG, signing, scanning, diffing, license scanning, tagging, quantization, evaluation, backup scheduling, multi-vault, policies, plugins, profiles, webhooks, ACL, validation, GC, and lineage-graph tools.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the RAG knowledge base using vector similarity (cosine distance). Returns ranked documents matching the query embedding.

query.description: The search query text to find similar documents

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: add_document
tools.description: Add a document to the RAG knowledge base. Documents are stored with optional metadata and embeddings for similarity search.

tools.name: chunk_text
tools.description: Split text into overlapping chunks for RAG ingestion. Uses configurable chunk size and overlap.

text.description: The text to split into chunks

overlap.description: Overlap between adjacent chunks in characters (default: 50)

tools.name: execute_rule
tools.description: Execute a business rule from the rule engine against a given context. Rules have conditions and actions executed by priority.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to execute

context.description: Key-value context for rule condition evaluation

tools.name: vault_init
tools.description: Initialize a new encrypted vault for storing AI models. Creates XDG-compliant directory structure with AES-256-GCM encryption.

name.description: Name of the vault to create (default: 'default')

tools.name: vault_store
tools.description: Store an AI model in the vault with encryption, versioning, and metadata. Supports 23+ model formats.

name.description: Name to store the model under

path.description: File path to the model to store

parent_version.description: Parent version number for lineage tracking

tools.name: vault_get
tools.description: Retrieve and decrypt a model from the vault. Verifies SHA-256 checksum on retrieval.

name.description: Name of the model to retrieve

output.description: Output file path for the decrypted model

tools.name: vault_list
tools.description: List all models stored in the vault with their versions, formats, and sizes.

tools.name: vault_versions
tools.description: List all versions of a specific model with timestamps, sizes, and parent lineage.

name.description: Model name to list versions for

tools.name: vault_lineage
tools.description: Show the version ancestry tree for a model version, tracing parent-child relationships.

version.description: Version number to trace lineage from

tools.name: model_convert
tools.description: Convert a model between formats. Supports PyTorch→SafeTensors/ONNX/TorchScript/CoreML/MLX, SafeTensors→GGUF, ONNX→TensorRT/OpenVINO/TFLite, TensorFlow→TFLite.

model.description: Name of the model to convert

tools.name: compliance_check
tools.description: Run FIPS 140-3, CMMC 2.0, and MITRE ATT&CK compliance checks against the vault configuration.

tools.name: cloud_push
tools.description: Push a model to cloud storage (AWS S3 or Azure Blob). The payload is sealed client-side with AES-256-GCM under an Argon2id key derived from the vault passphrase, so the object in the bucket is ciphertext. Requires the vault passphrase.

tools.name: cloud_pull
tools.description: Pull an encrypted model from cloud storage into the local vault.

tools.name: model_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a stored model — size, compression ratio, format details, parameter estimates.

tools.name: model_deduplicate
tools.description: Find duplicate models in the vault using SHA-256 hash comparison.

tools.name: vault_stats
tools.description: Get vault statistics — total models, versions, storage used, format distribution.

tools.name: database_search
tools.description: Full-text search across the RAG database (SQLite or Sled backend).

tools.name: model_pull
tools.description: Download a model from HuggingFace, Ollama, or a URL. Optionally verify SHA-256 and store in the vault.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the downloaded artifact

token.description: Bearer token for private HuggingFace repos

store.description: Also store the downloaded model in the vault

name.description: Vault model name when --store is used

tools.name: model_sign
tools.description: Generate an HMAC-SHA256 signature for a stored model or arbitrary file. Writes a detached .sig file.

identity.description: Signer identity recorded in the signature

file.description: Alternate file path to sign instead of vault content

tools.name: model_verify
tools.description: Verify an HMAC-SHA256 signature against a model or file.

tools.name: model_scan
tools.description: Scan a pickle / PyTorch file for dangerous opcodes (REDUCE, GLOBAL, INST, BUILD) and exploit patterns (os.system, eval, exec).

name.description: Vault model name (optional if file is provided)

tools.name: model_diff
tools.description: Diff two models at the tensor level. Inputs may be file paths or `name@version` references.

tools.name: model_validate
tools.description: Validate the SHA-256 integrity of one or all versions of a model.

tools.name: model_register
tools.description: Register a model with a local inference engine (Ollama or LM Studio).

tools.name: license_scan
tools.description: Detect licenses from model cards, config.json, GGUF metadata, or LICENSE files. Returns SPDX identifiers.

tools.name: tag_add
tools.description: Add one or more tags to a model.

tools.name: tag_remove
tools.description: Remove tags from a model.

tools.name: tag_list
tools.description: List all tags on a model.

tools.name: tag_annotate
tools.description: Attach a key-value annotation to a model.

tools.name: model_search
tools.description: Search vault models by name substring, tag, and/or annotation.

tools.name: vault_export
tools.description: Export the active vault as a portable tar.gz bundle.

tools.name: vault_import
tools.description: Import a vault bundle (tar.gz) into the target directory.

tools.name: gc_run
tools.description: Run garbage collection: prune orphaned blobs and stale temp files. Use dry_run to preview.

tools.name: webhook_add
tools.description: Register a webhook target with optional HMAC secret.

tools.name: webhook_remove
tools.description: Remove a webhook target by ID.

tools.name: webhook_list
tools.description: List all registered webhooks.

tools.name: webhook_test
tools.description: Send a test payload to a webhook to validate connectivity.

tools.name: acl_grant
tools.description: Grant a role (reader/writer/admin) to a principal.

tools.name: acl_revoke
tools.description: Revoke all access for a principal.

tools.name: acl_list
tools.description: List all ACL entries.

tools.name: acl_check
tools.description: Check whether a principal has a given role.

tools.name: policy_set
tools.description: Define a retention policy on a model (max versions, max age, keep minimum).

tools.name: policy_remove
tools.description: Remove the retention policy for a model.

tools.name: policy_list
tools.description: List all retention policies.

tools.name: policy_apply
tools.description: Apply the retention policy for a single model (dry-run supported).

tools.name: policy_apply_all
tools.description: Apply retention policies for all models with a policy.

tools.name: lineage_graph_add
tools.description: Record a derivation edge in the cross-model lineage DAG.

tools.name: lineage_graph_show
tools.description: Return the full cross-model lineage graph.

tools.name: lineage_graph_ancestors
tools.description: List ancestors of a model in the lineage DAG.

tools.name: lineage_graph_descendants
tools.description: List descendants of a model in the lineage DAG.

tools.name: plugin_discover
tools.description: Scan for installable plugins on the local filesystem.

tools.name: plugin_install
tools.description: Install a plugin from a JSON manifest path.

tools.name: plugin_uninstall
tools.description: Uninstall a plugin by ID.

tools.name: plugin_list
tools.description: List installed plugins.

tools.name: plugin_info
tools.description: Show details for an installed plugin.

tools.name: profile_create
tools.description: Create a configuration profile with optional overrides.

tools.name: profile_remove
tools.description: Remove a configuration profile.

tools.name: profile_list
tools.description: List all configuration profiles.

tools.name: profile_activate
tools.description: Activate a configuration profile by name.

tools.name: profile_deactivate
tools.description: Clear the active configuration profile.

tools.name: profile_show
tools.description: Show the active configuration profile.

tools.name: quant_set
tools.description: Set or update a quantization profile for a model version.

tools.name: quant_remove
tools.description: Remove a quantization profile.

tools.name: quant_list
tools.description: List quantization profiles (optionally filtered by model).

tools.name: quant_estimate
tools.description: Estimate the byte size after quantizing a model with a given method.

tools.name: eval_record
tools.description: Record an evaluation run with one or more metrics.

tools.name: eval_list
tools.description: List evaluation runs for a model, optionally filtered by version or suite.

tools.name: eval_compare
tools.description: Compare two or more versions of a model across recorded evaluation runs.

tools.name: eval_suites
tools.description: List known evaluation suites (mmlu, hellaswag, arc, …).

tools.name: backup_schedule
tools.description: Schedule a recurring vault backup (daily, weekly, monthly, or custom).

tools.name: backup_list
tools.description: List all backup schedules.

tools.name: backup_run
tools.description: Run an immediate backup of a vault (or all scheduled vaults if vault is omitted).

tools.name: backup_history
tools.description: Show backup history, optionally filtered by vault.

tools.name: vaults_register
tools.description: Register a vault by name and path in the multi-vault registry.

tools.name: vaults_unregister
tools.description: Unregister a vault by name.

tools.name: vaults_list
tools.description: List all registered vaults.

tools.name: vaults_activate
tools.description: Switch the active vault.

tools.name: vaults_active
tools.description: Show the currently active vault.

tools.name: benchmark_add
tools.description: Record a benchmark score for a model version.

tools.name: benchmark_show
tools.description: Show benchmark scores for a model.

tools.name: card_create
tools.description: Create a model card for a stored model.

tools.name: card_show
tools.description: Retrieve a model card.

tools.name: card_validate
tools.description: Validate a model card against the schema.

tools.name: cloud_list
tools.description: List models stored on a cloud provider.

tools.name: introspect
tools.description: Return the full CLI schema (commands, options, examples) for agent bootstrapping.

resources.name: Vault Models
resources.description: List of all models in the current vault with versions and metadata

resources.name: Vault Statistics
resources.description: Aggregate statistics about vault contents, storage, and formats

resources.name: Compliance Report
resources.description: FIPS/CMMC/MITRE compliance status for the current vault

resources.name: Model Card
resources.description: Model card documentation for a specific model

resources.name: Model Versions
resources.description: Version history and lineage for a specific model

resources.name: RAG Documents
resources.description: List of documents in the RAG knowledge base

resources.name: Conversion Paths
resources.description: Supported format conversion paths and quantization schemes

prompts.name: store_model
prompts.description: Guide storing a new AI model in the vault with proper metadata

prompts.name: convert_model
prompts.description: Guide converting a model between formats with optimal settings

prompts.name: compliance_audit
prompts.description: Run a full compliance audit and explain results

prompts.name: setup_rag
prompts.description: Guide setting up a RAG knowledge base with documents
